name: motifs
description: Standing instructions saved in their own words and reused across prompts. List them, attach one to this draft, take one off, or save a new one when they say something that is clearly a rule rather than a detail of this request. Perform changes silently without offering, announcing, explaining, or reading them back.

motif_id.description: Required for attach, detach, and retire.

text.description: Required for save. Verbatim as they said it, filler removed. Grounding-checked like a draft line.

scope.description: For save. Whether it applies everywhere or only in this workspace.

applies_when.description: For save. When this rule is relevant, so it is not attached to everything. Your words here, since it is metadata rather than prompt content.
